knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Loading packages

```{r packages}
library(here)
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Import dataset

```{r Reading Dataset, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
All_Country <- read_csv("Data/Processed/AllCountries_Processed.csv")
```

##Data Cleaning

I will add stuff to this chunk and use the summary function later to check for weird data. And come back to add to this chunk AGAIN >:(

```{r data cleaning}
##Change code to NA
All_Country$DwellingType[All_Country$DwellingType == 555] <- NA
All_Country$BankAccount[All_Country$BankAccount == 111] <- NA


##Remove extreme values
All_Country$DwellingRoomsNumber[All_Country$DwellingRoomsNumber >= 500] <- NA

All_Country$NumYearsGridConnected[All_Country$NumYearsGridConnected >= 720] <- NA


##Remove unknown categories

All_Country$GridConnectionFeeLocal[All_Country$GridConnectionFeeLocal < 0] <- NA
All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD[All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD < 0] <- NA

All_Country$WillingToPayForConnection[All_Country$WillingToPayForConnection >= 3] <- NA


##Special
#BankAccount = 3 means joint account with spouse, so I consider it yes. (2 is yes 1 is no)
All_Country$BankAccount[All_Country$BankAccount == 3] <- 2

#GridConnectionFee = 111 means household is already connected, so spent 0.
All_Country$GridConnectionFeeLocal[All_Country$GridConnectionFeeLocal == 111] <- 0
All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD[All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD == 1.088235294] <- 0
All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD[All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD == 1.0882353] <- 0
All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD[All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD == 1.088235] <- 0
All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD[All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD == 1.178344] <- 0
All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD[All_Country$GridConnectionFeeUSD == 0.209434] <- 0

#UrbanOrRural = 3 is peri-urban, basically transition zone, for the purpose of the analysis, removed.
All_Country$UrbanOrRural[All_Country$UrbanOrRural == 3] <- NA
```


## Dataset Structure & Summary

```{r structure & summary}
dim(All_Country)
summary(All_Country)
```

## Creating Table

Here are the variables I used: UrbanOrRural, HouseholdSize, DwellingOwnership, DwellingRoomsNumber, BankAccount, GridConnected, NumYearsGridConnected, GridConnectionFeeUSD, InternalWiringFeeUSD, ElectricityBillPriceUSD, ElectricityConsumptionkWh, OutageDurationHours, MobilePhonesOwned, WillingToPayForConnection, EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD

I didn't use: ElectrificationStatus, DwellingType, GridConnectionFeeLocal, InternalWiringFeeLocal, ElectricityBillPriceLocal, EstimateOfElectricitySpendingLocal

```{r country summary table}
Country_Summary <- All_Country %>% 
  group_by(Country) %>% 
  summarise(
    Percent_Urban = mean(UrbanOrRural == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Mean_HouseholdSize = mean(HouseholdSize, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent_OwnDwelling = mean(DwellingOwnership == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Mean_DwellingRoomsNumber = mean(DwellingRoomsNumber, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent_OwnBankAccount = mean(BankAccount == 2, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Percent_GridConnected = mean(GridConnected == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Mean_YearsConnected = mean(NumYearsGridConnected, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_GridConnectionUSD = mean(GridConnectionFeeUSD, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_InternalWiringUSD = mean(InternalWiringFeeUSD, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_ElectricityBillUSD = mean(ElectricityBillPriceUSD, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_ElectricityConsumptionkWh = mean(ElectricityConsumptionkWh, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_OutageHours = mean(OutageDurationHours, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_MobilePhone = mean(MobilePhonesOwned, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent_WillingToPayForConnection = mean(
      WillingToPayForConnection == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    Mean_EstimateSpendingUSD = mean(EstimateOfElectricitySpendingUSD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Write csv
```{r write csv}
write.csv(Country_Summary, "Data/Processed/Country_Summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Subdivision1_Summary, "Data/Processed/Subdivision1_Summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(Subdivision2_Summary, "Data/Processed/Subdivision2_Summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
